violations.affected_code: InkWell(onTap: () async { await Clipboard.setData(...) ... }, child: const Padding(... child: Icon(Icons.content_copy, size: 16)))
violations.explanation: Icon-only interactive control has no semanticLabel, tooltip, or Semantics label, so screen readers announce it as an unlabeled button.

violations.affected_code: InkWell(onTap: onShowQrCode, child: const Padding(... child: Icon(Icons.qr_code, size: 16)))
violations.explanation: Icon-only button for showing QR code lacks an accessible label; its purpose is not conveyed to assistive technologies.

violations.affected_code: InkWell(onTap: onShowZoom, child: const Padding(... child: Icon(Icons.tv, size: 16)))
violations.explanation: Icon-only button for zoom/present mode lacks an accessible label; the TV icon's meaning is ambiguous and not announced.

violations.affected_code: Padding(padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 2), child: Icon(..., size: 16))
violations.explanation: Each tappable area is about 32x20 logical pixels, well below the recommended 48x48 minimum touch target size.
InkWell does not expose a button role by itself; without Semantics(button: true) or using IconButton, controls may not be identified as buttons.
Unconstrained SelectableText in a Row (not wrapped in Expanded/Flexible) can overflow with long URLs or larger text scaling, pushing buttons off-screen.
